moa.t: Stimulates oxytocin receptors on the myometrium, causing rhythmic contractions, short half-life

contraindications.t: Fetal distress or obstructed labour (for augmentation)

cautions.t: Never give an IV bolus for induction or augmentation – infusion only
Give IM or slow IV for third-stage management

adverse_effects.t: Uterine hyperstimulation, fetal distress, uterine rupture, hypotension and tachycardia with rapid IV bolus, water intoxication and hyponatraemia with prolonged high-dose infusion

monitoring.t: Contractions, fetal heart rate, BP, fluid balance
